usage: music-tagger lyrics-batch [-h] [--embed] [--dry-run] [--auto]
                                 [--pending PENDING] [--decisions DECISIONS]
                                 [--log LOG | --no-log]
                                 path

Backfill lyrics across a library. Each track without lyrics gets a sidecar
only when exactly one LRCLIB record is certain. Every other track is saved to
the pending file with its candidate records, for lyrics-decide. With --embed,
sidecars are also written into tags. Tracks that already have lyrics, or a
recorded decision, are never searched.

positional arguments:
  path                  Library root, artist directory, or album directory.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --embed               Also write each track's sidecar into its tags.
  --dry-run             Show what would be written. Writes no sidecars, tags,
                        log, or pending file.
  --auto                Also record the choices the rules accept without a
                        judgment: a plausible album match with synchronized
                        text, or an album match within 5 s whose last line
                        falls inside the audio. The rest stay pending.
  --pending PENDING     Pending options file (default:
                        $MUSIC_TAGGER_LYRICS_PENDING, else ~/Projects/music-
                        tagger/lyrics-pending.json).
  --decisions DECISIONS
                        Decisions file (default:
                        $MUSIC_TAGGER_LYRICS_DECISIONS, else ~/Projects/music-
                        tagger/lyrics-decisions.json).
  --log LOG             Append changes to this log file (default:
                        $MUSIC_TAGGER_LOG, else ~/Projects/music-
                        tagger/changes.log).
  --no-log              Do not write the change log.
